item.title: Dothan Library halts passport services after ruling change
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala. (WDHN) -- The Dothan Houston County Library System has ceased passport processing at all of its locations, effective immediately. This decision followed a regulation from the United States State Department barring nonprofit public libraries from operating as passport acceptance centers.
